article.title: Futuro imperfectivo буду + infinitivo
article.part: Sistema verbal básico — Базовая глагольная система
article.chapter: Pasado y futuro — Прошедшее и будущее время

claims.summary: The Russian future imperfective is formed with a future form of 'быть' plus the infinitive of the main verb, indicating a future action as a process or habitual situation.
The future auxiliary 'быть' changes according to person and number, while the main verb remains in the infinitive form, preserving its imperfective aspect.
The article provides examples of the future imperfective construction in Russian, such as 'Завтра я буду работать дома.' and 'Мы будем читать вечером.'
The future imperfective does not mean 'unfinished action'; it presents the situation without focusing on its completion, contrasting with the perfective future simple.
